field.name: webmfID
field.comment: The ID of the WebM file of the video (0 or NULL: none)

field.name: oggfID
field.comment: The ID of the Ogg file of the video (0 or NULL: none)

field.name: posterfID
field.comment: The ID of the image displayed until the video is played (0 or NULL: none)

field.name: mp4fID
field.comment: The ID of the MP4 file of the video (0 or NULL: none)

field.name: videoSize
field.comment: 0 or NULL: the video keeps its own size; 1: it fills the width available; 2: it's at most width pixels wide

field.name: width
field.comment: The maximum width of the video, in pixels (used if videoSize is 2)

field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed above the video
